headline: National Trust opens new 32-hectare park at Saltram
summary: Former agricultural land in Plymouth has become public parkland, including a 2.5km accessible trail for walkers, cyclists and wheelchair users.
script: A former agricultural field in Plymouth has opened as public parkland. The National Trust's new thirty-two hectare park at Saltram includes a two and a half kilometre trail for walkers, cyclists and wheelchair users, funded by Sport England.
imageAlt: A wooden wayfinding sign beside a path in the new Saltram parkland.
imageAltTwo: A view across the new park's fields and trail near Plymouth.
